title.zh-CN: 癌症谱系与治疗证据地图
title.en: Cancer spectrum and treatment evidence map

intro.zh-CN: 从癌症起源、病理分支和分期进入治疗路径，查看 2024 年全球负担与可追溯证据。目录采用 34 个统计组，并补充其他已知原发癌和原发灶不明癌；乳腺癌与结直肠癌连接既有病症正文。
intro.en: Explore cancers by origin, pathology and stage, with treatment pathways, 2024 global burden and traceable evidence. The map uses 34 statistical groups plus other specified primaries and unknown primary; breast and colorectal entries link to existing condition articles.

text.zh-CN:
每个条目只归一个主组。先按白血病、淋巴瘤、骨髓瘤等血液病诊断归组；Kaposi 肉瘤和间皮瘤也优先归各自专组，其发生部位不再建立第二个条目。其余癌症按原发器官归组；位于子宫等已列器官的肉瘤仍在该器官组，其他骨与软组织原发癌进入“其他已知原发癌”。

转移灶沿用原发癌归属，例如乳腺癌脑转移仍属于乳腺癌。儿童、遗传倾向、分子标志物和分期是同一癌症的描述轴，不另加癌种计数。确已诊断恶性肿瘤但经过相应检查仍未找到原发部位，才进入原发灶不明组。

这是一套用于知识导航的归属规则，并非逐例登记编码工具。统计组采用原论文名称：乳腺负担只统计女性；男性乳腺癌在其他已知原发组导航。
text.en:
Each entry has one primary group. Leukemias, lymphomas and myeloma are assigned by hematologic diagnosis; Kaposi sarcoma and mesothelioma also take priority over organ location. Other cancers follow their primary organ. Sarcomas in a listed organ, such as the uterus, stay there; other bone and soft-tissue primaries go under other specified cancers.

Metastases remain assigned to the original cancer: breast cancer spreading to the brain remains breast cancer. Childhood, inherited susceptibility, molecular features and stage describe a cancer rather than create additional cancer counts. Unknown primary applies after an appropriate investigation has failed to identify the origin of a confirmed malignancy.

These are knowledge-navigation rules, not a case-level registry coding tool. Group names follow the paper: its breast burden covers females; male breast cancer is navigated under other specified primaries.

title.zh-CN: 人数、死亡率与统计年份
title.en: Counts, mortality rates and statistical years

text.zh-CN:
GLOBOCAN 2024 原论文表 1 估计全球新增癌症 20,636,778 例、死亡 9,762,507 人，覆盖 186 个国家。以下各组人数均来自同一表；“2024”是估计年份，论文发表于 2026 年。

新发与死亡是当年两个不同人群的统计，死亡/新发之比不是个人病死概率，也不是治疗失败率。病例总数受人口规模和老龄化影响；比较不同地区或年代的患癌风险，要同时看年龄标化率和数据质量。跨版估计可能随模型与登记资料修订，不能直接用两个版本差值当作趋势。

论文表中的非黑色素瘤皮肤癌不含基底细胞癌，因此它不等于全部皮肤癌负担。其他已知原发癌与原发灶不明癌没有从表 1 获得可独立使用的全球人数，本页不拆算。
text.en:
GLOBOCAN 2024 Table 1 estimates 20,636,778 new cancers and 9,762,507 deaths worldwide across 186 countries. Every group count below uses that table. The estimates concern 2024; the paper was published in 2026.

New cases and deaths describe different populations within a year. Their ratio is neither an individual fatality probability nor a treatment-failure rate. Counts depend on population size and aging; comparisons of risk across places or time also require age-standardized rates and data-quality assessment. Revised models and registry inputs can change estimates, so differences between editions do not directly establish a trend.

The table excludes basal cell carcinoma from nonmelanoma skin cancer, so that count is not the total skin-cancer burden. Table 1 does not supply separately usable global counts for other specified primaries and unknown primary; no residual counts are assigned here.

title.en: From diagnosis to a treatment decision

text.zh-CN:
路径：确认病理与原发部位 → 评估扩散范围 → 检测会改变治疗的标志物 → 评估器官功能、体能、生育与个人目标 → 选择并复评方案。

实体瘤常用 TNM 描述原发肿瘤、淋巴结和远处转移；脑肿瘤和血液肿瘤另有分类与风险体系。临床分期基于治疗前检查，病理分期加入手术标本结果；治疗后的反应评价另行记录。初诊分期保留为历史信息，不因治疗缩小就改写初诊阶段。

新辅助治疗在局部治疗之前，辅助治疗用于局部治疗之后降低复发风险。分子检测帮助匹配疗法；肿瘤体细胞变化与可遗传的胚系变化含义不同，检测出变化也未必已有有效药物。
text.en:
Pathway: confirm pathology and origin → assess spread → test biomarkers that can change treatment → assess organ function, fitness, fertility and personal goals → select and reassess a plan.

TNM commonly describes the primary tumor, nodes and distant metastases in solid cancers. Brain and blood cancers use other classifications and risk systems. Clinical stage uses pretreatment findings; pathological stage adds surgical findings. Treatment response is recorded separately. The original stage remains part of the history rather than being rewritten when a tumor shrinks.

Neoadjuvant treatment precedes local treatment; adjuvant treatment follows it to reduce recurrence risk. Molecular testing can match treatments to tumors. Somatic tumor changes differ from inherited germline changes, and a detected alteration does not necessarily have an effective matched drug.

text.zh-CN:
先看研究人群、病理/标志物、治疗线次和对照方案，再看结局及随访时间。总生存期（OS）观察任何原因死亡；无进展生存期（PFS）观察进展或死亡；肿瘤缩小、病理缓解与生活质量又是不同结局。某一结局改善，不能自动换算为另一个结局改善。

五年相对生存率把患者生存与可比一般人群相比，是群体描述；它不等于“还能活五年”，也不能直接用于预测某个人。不同国家、诊断年份、分期与随访条件下的数值需要分别读。

原始试验、系统综述和专业指南承担不同证据职责。查看随机化、样本量、不确定区间、毒性和绝对获益；临床试验登记说明研究正在做什么，不等于疗效已经证实。
text.en:
Read the population, pathology or biomarkers, treatment line and comparator before the outcome and follow-up duration. Overall survival (OS) concerns death from any cause; progression-free survival (PFS) concerns progression or death. Tumor shrinkage, pathological response and quality of life are separate outcomes. Improvement in one does not automatically establish improvement in another.

Five-year relative survival compares survival among people with cancer with a comparable general population. It does not mean someone has five years to live or directly predict an individual outcome. Country, diagnosis period, stage and follow-up conditions matter.

Original trials, systematic reviews and guidelines serve different purposes. Examine randomization, sample size, uncertainty, toxicity and absolute benefit. A trial registration describes a study rather than proving that its treatment works.

title.zh-CN: 费用按国家、价格年与治疗时期读
title.en: Read costs by country, price year and care phase

text.zh-CN:
美国 NCI 汇总的 2007–2013 年 Medicare 理赔研究，将患者与无癌症匹配对照的费用差额作为癌症归因费用，并换算为 2020 年美元。全癌种每人年均医疗服务费用约为：初诊后第一年 43,516 美元；持续照护期 5,518 美元；癌症死亡前最后一年 109,727 美元。口服处方药费用在该来源另表列出，未合入上述金额。

这是历史人群均值，既不是个人自付额，也不是当前中国医院报价。做个人预算时分别询问检查、治疗、支持照护、复诊与交通误工，以及医保/保险支付后的自付；同时说明治疗目标与预计周期。
text.en:
An NCI summary uses 2007–2013 US Medicare claims, subtracting matched non-cancer costs to estimate cancer-attributable spending in 2020 US dollars. Across cancer sites, annualized medical-service costs per person were about $43,516 in the first year after diagnosis, $5,518 during continuing care and $109,727 in the year before cancer death. Oral prescription drugs are tabulated separately and are not included in those amounts.

These historical averages are neither personal out-of-pocket bills nor current hospital prices in China. For a personal budget, separate testing, treatment, supportive care, follow-up, travel and lost work, then establish insurance coverage and remaining personal costs, treatment goals and expected duration.

text.zh-CN:
疼痛、呼吸困难、营养、疲劳、情绪、照护者负担和费用问题可以从确诊时一起处理。姑息照护可与根治性或延长生命的治疗同时进行，不必等到停止抗肿瘤治疗。

随访有三项任务：评估疗效或复发、发现治疗毒性、恢复功能与生活质量。检查种类与频率按癌种、分期、治疗和新症状安排；同一种“肿瘤标志物”不能通用于所有癌症。治疗路径中的药物类别需要与病理、标志物、器官功能及当地可及性匹配。
text.en:
Pain, breathlessness, nutrition, fatigue, emotions, caregiver needs and financial concerns can be addressed from diagnosis. Palliative care can accompany curative or life-prolonging cancer treatment.

Follow-up assesses response or recurrence, identifies treatment toxicity and supports function and quality of life. Tests and timing depend on the cancer, stage, treatment and new symptoms; one tumor marker does not monitor every cancer. Drug categories in the pathways must be matched to pathology, biomarkers, organ function and local availability.

summary.zh-CN: 原发于气管、支气管或肺组织的癌症。治疗首先区分非小细胞与小细胞类型。
summary.en: Cancers starting in the trachea, bronchi or lung. The first treatment distinction is non-small-cell versus small-cell disease.

text.zh-CN: 非小细胞肺癌包括腺癌、鳞癌等；分期、可切除性和可用靶点共同决定方案。小细胞肺癌生长和治疗方式不同，常按局限期、广泛期规划。
text.en: Non-small-cell cancers include adenocarcinoma and squamous carcinoma; stage, resectability and actionable markers guide treatment. Small-cell cancer follows a different course and is commonly planned as limited- or extensive-stage disease.

text.zh-CN:
- 早期非小细胞：手术；不适合手术者可评估立体定向放疗。围手术期全身治疗按风险与标志物选择。
- 不可切除局部晚期：放化疗，并按分子特征和适应证评估巩固免疫或靶向治疗。
- 转移性非小细胞：先匹配可用靶点与免疫相关标志物，再选择靶向、免疫及化疗组合。
- 小细胞：局限期以放化疗为主；广泛期常用化疗联合免疫，随后复评。
text.en:
- Early non-small-cell disease: surgery, or stereotactic radiation when surgery is unsuitable; perioperative systemic treatment depends on risk and markers.
- Unresectable locally advanced disease: chemoradiation, with consolidation immunotherapy or targeted treatment according to molecular findings and eligibility.
- Metastatic non-small-cell disease: match actionable and immune-related markers before selecting targeted, immune and chemotherapy options.
- Small-cell disease: chemoradiation for limited disease; chemotherapy with immunotherapy commonly for extensive disease, followed by reassessment.

text.zh-CN: 用影像比较治疗前后的病灶，同时监测呼吸症状、体能和治疗相关肺部等毒性。
text.en: Compare imaging with baseline while tracking breathing, function and treatment toxicities, including lung effects.
Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 2,637,005 new cases and 1,861,839 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 这里补充分期与分子治疗地图；症状、就医与日常管理见既有乳腺癌正文。
summary.en: This entry adds stage and molecular treatment mapping; the existing breast-cancer article covers symptoms, care seeking and daily management.

text.zh-CN: 病理报告区分原位与浸润性病变，并报告分级、雌/孕激素受体（ER/PR）及人表皮生长因子受体 2（HER2，帮助匹配相应靶向治疗）。三阴性指 ER、PR 与 HER2 均阴性，不是额外的器官癌种。
text.en: Pathology distinguishes in-situ from invasive disease and reports grade, estrogen/progesterone receptors (ER/PR) and human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2, used to match HER2-targeted treatment). Triple-negative means all three are negative; it is a subtype, not another organ cancer.

text.zh-CN:
- 可手术病变：局部手术与放疗安排结合肿瘤范围；全身治疗按受体、风险和术前/术后阶段选择。
- 局部进展或需要缩瘤：可先全身治疗，术后再结合残余病灶调整。
- 转移性病变：激素受体阳性、HER2 阳性与三阴性各有不同系统治疗路线；重新评估病灶标志物可改变选药。
text.en:
- Operable disease: plan surgery and radiation by extent; systemic treatment depends on receptors, risk and the preoperative or postoperative setting.
- Locally advanced disease or a need for downstaging: systemic treatment may precede surgery; residual disease can guide postoperative changes.
- Metastatic disease: hormone-receptor-positive, HER2-positive and triple-negative cancers have different systemic pathways; reassessing markers can change treatment.

text.zh-CN: 复评既看病灶反应，也看长期内分泌或其他系统治疗的耐受；治疗反应与初诊分期分别记录。
text.en: Review tumor response and tolerance of ongoing endocrine or other systemic treatment; record response separately from the original stage.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 2,434,087 例，死亡 693,660 人。此统计仅限女性。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 2,434,087 new cases and 693,660 deaths. This estimate covers females only.

summary.zh-CN: 结肠与直肠共享统计组，但局部治疗顺序不同；通用症状和日常管理连接既有正文。
summary.en: Colon and rectal cancers share a statistical group but differ in local treatment sequence; the existing article provides general symptoms and daily care.

text.zh-CN: 确认结肠或直肠原发、浸润深度及淋巴结/远处病灶。错配修复/微卫星状态（反映肿瘤 DNA 修复与短重复序列的稳定性）及可用分子靶点会改变部分全身治疗选择。
text.en: Establish colon versus rectal origin, invasion depth, nodes and distant disease. Mismatch-repair or microsatellite status (features of tumor DNA repair and short-repeat stability) and actionable targets can change systemic options.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限性结肠癌：以切除为主；淋巴结阳性等风险决定辅助治疗。
- 局部进展直肠癌：常把化疗、放疗与手术按计划组合；临床完全缓解后的非手术观察仅适用于经过专科评估并能严密随访的选择性人群。
- 转移性病变：按分子特征选全身治疗，并评估部分肝/肺局限转移是否有局部治疗机会。
text.en:
- Localized colon cancer: resection; nodal involvement and other risks guide adjuvant treatment.
- Locally advanced rectal cancer: planned combinations of chemotherapy, radiation and surgery. Nonoperative observation after a clinical complete response is reserved for selected patients with specialist assessment and close surveillance.
- Metastatic disease: marker-guided systemic treatment and assessment of local treatment for selected limited liver or lung metastases.

text.zh-CN: 术后或非手术观察采用与治疗路径对应的复评方案；不能把影像缩小直接等同于病理完全缓解。
text.en: Use follow-up appropriate to surgery or nonoperative surveillance; radiographic shrinkage does not by itself establish a pathological complete response.
Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 2,041,007 new cases and 917,895 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 发生于前列腺的癌症；进展速度差异很大，部分低风险病变可先主动监测。
summary.en: A cancer of the prostate with widely varying behavior; selected low-risk disease can begin with active surveillance.

text.zh-CN: 把 前列腺特异抗原（PSA）血液检测、病理分级与分期一起分层；晚期还要区分激素敏感和去势抵抗状态。主动监测有预定复查和转治疗条件。
text.en: Combine the prostate-specific antigen (PSA) blood test, pathological grade and stage. Advanced disease is further separated into hormone-sensitive and castration-resistant states. Active surveillance includes scheduled review and treatment triggers.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限低风险：在适合者中比较主动监测、手术与放疗的获益和功能影响。
- 较高风险或局部进展：手术或放疗路径，部分需联合激素治疗。
- 转移或复发：抑制雄激素的系统治疗并评估强化方案；去势抵抗后按既往治疗、基因特征与症状重新选药。
text.en:
- Localized low risk: compare active surveillance, surgery and radiation in eligible patients, including functional effects.
- Higher risk or locally advanced: surgery or radiation pathways, sometimes combined with hormone treatment.
- Metastatic or recurrent: androgen-directed systemic treatment with assessment for intensification; subsequent selection considers prior treatment, genomic findings and symptoms.

text.zh-CN: 随访 PSA 趋势、影像或症状变化，并评估排尿、性功能及激素治疗相关骨健康。
text.en: Follow PSA trends, imaging or symptoms, and assess urinary and sexual function and bone health during hormone treatment.
Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 1,546,112 new cases and 419,849 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 胃黏膜来源的腺癌是主要临床路径；发生在胃的淋巴瘤按淋巴瘤归组。
summary.en: The main pathway concerns adenocarcinoma arising from the stomach lining; gastric lymphoma belongs to the lymphoma group.

text.zh-CN: 记录病理与胃内位置、浸润范围和淋巴结。晚期检测可用的 HER2（帮助匹配相应靶向药的受体标志物）、免疫相关及其他治疗靶点；不同阳性结果对应不同用药条件。
text.en: Record pathology, gastric location, invasion and nodes. Advanced disease may be tested for HER2 (a receptor marker used to match targeted treatment), immune-related markers and other actionable targets, each with its own treatment eligibility.

text.zh-CN:
- 部分小而浅、淋巴结转移风险低的病变：可内镜切除。
- 可切除浸润癌：胃切除与淋巴结处理，结合围手术期或术后治疗。
- 不可切除/转移：按标志物选化疗、靶向或免疫组合，同时处理出血、梗阻和进食问题。
text.en:
- Selected small superficial lesions with low nodal risk: endoscopic resection.
- Resectable invasive disease: gastrectomy and nodal management with perioperative or postoperative treatment.
- Unresectable or metastatic disease: marker-selected chemotherapy, targeted or immune combinations, alongside treatment of bleeding, obstruction and eating difficulties.

text.zh-CN: 复评影像反应、体重与营养；胃切除后的饮食和吸收变化需要持续处理。
text.en: Reassess imaging response, weight and nutrition; eating and absorption changes after gastrectomy need continuing care.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 980,286 例，死亡 641,554 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 980,286 new cases and 641,554 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 甲状腺癌包含治疗差异明显的分化型、髓样和未分化类型。
summary.en: Thyroid cancer includes differentiated, medullary and anaplastic types with substantially different treatment paths.

text.zh-CN: 乳头状/滤泡癌属于分化型；髓样癌起源于 C 细胞；未分化癌常需快速评估。放射性碘是否有用取决于类型及摄碘能力。
text.en: Papillary and follicular cancers are differentiated; medullary cancer arises from C cells. Anaplastic cancer often needs rapid assessment. Radioactive iodine depends on tumor type and iodine uptake.

text.zh-CN:
- 分化型：以手术为主，按复发风险选择放射性碘及甲状腺激素管理。
- 髓样癌：手术和必要的系统治疗；放射性碘不用于此类型。
- 未分化或进展性疾病：结合可切除性、分子结果与全身情况，评估放疗、靶向/其他系统治疗和气道支持。
text.en:
- Differentiated disease: surgery, with risk-selected radioactive iodine and thyroid-hormone management.
- Medullary disease: surgery and systemic treatment when needed; radioactive iodine is not used for this type.
- Anaplastic or progressive disease: assess resectability, molecular findings and fitness for radiation, targeted or other systemic treatment and airway support.

text.zh-CN: 随访按病理类型安排颈部与血液评估，同时检查甲状腺激素及术后功能问题。
text.en: Tailor neck and blood assessments to pathology while reviewing thyroid hormone levels and postoperative function.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 959,281 例，死亡 48,070 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 959,281 new cases and 48,070 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 本统计组包含肝细胞癌和肝内胆管癌；其他癌症转移到肝不归此组。
summary.en: This statistical group includes hepatocellular and intrahepatic bile-duct cancers; metastases to the liver remain under their original cancer.

text.zh-CN: 肝细胞癌的决策同时看肿瘤范围、肝功能与体能。肝内胆管癌属于另一病理路径；肝门部和远端胆管癌归其他已知原发组。
text.en: Hepatocellular decisions combine tumor extent, liver function and fitness. Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma follows a separate pathological pathway; perihilar and distal bile-duct cancers are under other specified primaries.

text.zh-CN:
- 肝细胞癌局限且肝储备允许：评估切除、消融或移植。
- 不可切除病变：结合分布与肝功能评估局部介入、放疗或免疫/靶向系统治疗。
- 肝内胆管癌：可切除者走手术路径；不可切除者评估系统治疗、可用标志物和胆道引流需求。
text.en:
- Localized hepatocellular cancer with sufficient liver reserve: assess resection, ablation or transplantation.
- Unresectable disease: consider liver-directed treatment, radiation or immune/targeted systemic therapy according to distribution and liver function.
- Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: surgery when resectable; otherwise assess systemic treatment, actionable markers and biliary drainage needs.

text.zh-CN: 肿瘤影像与肝功能一起复查；黄疸、腹水等变化会影响下一步治疗。
text.en: Review tumor imaging and liver function together; changes such as jaundice or ascites can alter treatment choices.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 843,045 例，死亡 732,489 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 843,045 new cases and 732,489 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 膀胱癌的关键分界是肿瘤是否侵入肌层，这会改变局部治疗强度。
summary.en: Whether a bladder tumor has invaded muscle is a key divide that changes the intensity of local treatment.

text.zh-CN: 主要路径为尿路上皮癌。非肌层浸润癌还按分级、大小、数量、原位癌和复发情况分风险。
text.en: The principal pathway is urothelial cancer. Non-muscle-invasive disease is further stratified by grade, size, number, carcinoma in situ and recurrence.

text.zh-CN:
- 非肌层浸润：经尿道切除并按风险选择膀胱内治疗；高危或治疗无效者评估膀胱切除。
- 肌层浸润：根治性膀胱切除与围手术期治疗，或适合者采用保膀胱放化疗。
- 转移性：系统治疗可涉及抗体药物偶联物、免疫或化疗，按身体条件和既往治疗选择。
text.en:
- Non-muscle-invasive: transurethral resection and risk-selected intravesical therapy; assess cystectomy for high-risk or treatment-resistant disease.
- Muscle-invasive: radical cystectomy with perioperative treatment, or bladder-preserving chemoradiation in suitable patients.
- Metastatic: systemic options include antibody-drug conjugates, immunotherapy and chemotherapy, selected by fitness and prior treatment.

text.zh-CN: 保膀胱者以膀胱镜等监测复发；接受尿流改道者还需评估排尿通路、肾功能和生活适应。
text.en: After bladder preservation, use cystoscopy and other indicated tests for recurrence; after urinary diversion, also review drainage, kidney function and adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 635,264 例，死亡 227,626 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 635,264 new cases and 227,626 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 原发于宫颈的癌症；治疗需要把肿瘤范围与生育目标一起考虑。
summary.en: Cancer originating in the cervix; treatment considers tumor extent alongside fertility goals.

text.zh-CN: 病理区分鳞癌、腺癌等。局限宫颈、盆腔扩展和远处转移需要不同组合；保留生育能力只适用于部分小而局限的病变。
text.en: Pathology distinguishes squamous, glandular and other types. Cervix-confined, pelvic and distant disease require different combinations; fertility preservation is limited to selected small localized tumors.

text.zh-CN:
- 部分早期：锥切、宫颈或子宫手术并评估淋巴结。
- 局部进展：常用同步放化疗，放疗包括外照射与近距离治疗；部分符合条件者加入免疫。
- 转移/复发：按既往治疗、病灶范围和标志物评估系统治疗；选择性局部复发仍需评估局部挽救机会。
text.en:
- Selected early disease: conization or cervical/uterine surgery with nodal assessment.
- Locally advanced: commonly concurrent chemoradiation with external-beam and brachytherapy components; immunotherapy may be added when eligible.
- Metastatic or recurrent: systemic treatment according to prior therapy, extent and markers; selected local recurrences merit assessment for local salvage.

text.zh-CN: 随访盆腔症状与治疗反应，并关注膀胱、肠道、性功能和生育影响。
text.en: Follow pelvic symptoms and response, with attention to bladder, bowel, sexual and fertility effects.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 604,196 例，死亡 279,583 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 604,196 new cases and 279,583 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 一组来自淋巴细胞的恶性疾病，可发生在淋巴结或器官；器官位置不改变其淋巴瘤归属。
summary.en: A diverse group of lymphocyte cancers arising in nodes or organs; organ location does not change lymphoma classification.

text.zh-CN: 先区分 B、T 或 NK 细胞来源与具体病理，再看惰性或侵袭性行为。胃和中枢神经系统淋巴瘤在本组，不另计胃癌或脑癌。
text.en: Establish B-, T- or NK-cell lineage and the specific pathology, then indolent versus aggressive behavior. Gastric and CNS lymphomas stay here rather than being counted again as stomach or brain cancer.

text.zh-CN:
- 部分无症状惰性病变：可按明确计划观察；局限病变可有局部放疗等路径。
- 需要治疗的惰性或侵袭性淋巴瘤：依亚型使用抗体、化疗或其他系统方案，不能仅凭“第几期”选药。
- 复发/难治：按亚型和前线治疗评估挽救方案、移植、CAR-T（改造 T 细胞，使其识别并攻击癌细胞的治疗） 或双特异性抗体等适用机会。
text.en:
- Selected asymptomatic indolent disease: planned observation; localized disease may have local radiation options.
- Indolent disease requiring treatment or aggressive lymphoma: subtype-specific antibodies, chemotherapy or other systemic regimens, rather than stage alone.
- Relapsed or refractory disease: assess salvage treatment, transplantation, CAR-T (chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy, which engineers T cells to recognize and attack cancer cells) or bispecific antibodies according to subtype and prior therapy.

text.zh-CN: 通过症状、血液与适用影像评价反应，同时监测感染及治疗毒性；观察期也有主动复诊计划。
text.en: Assess response with symptoms, blood tests and appropriate imaging while monitoring infection and toxicity; observation includes active follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 562,793 例，死亡 234,903 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 562,793 new cases and 234,903 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 胰腺导管腺癌与胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤是不同路径，不能共用一种“胰腺癌方案”。
summary.en: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors follow different pathways.

text.zh-CN: 导管腺癌先评估能否完整切除；神经内分泌肿瘤还要看分化、生长速度、激素功能和受体特征。
text.en: For ductal adenocarcinoma, assess complete resectability first. Neuroendocrine tumors also require assessment of differentiation, growth, hormone function and receptor features.

text.zh-CN:
- 导管腺癌可切除：手术与围手术期系统治疗；局部进展或转移以系统治疗和症状处理为主。
- 神经内分泌肿瘤：选择性小而缓慢的无功能病变可监测；其他病变可评估手术、生长抑素类似物、靶向、化疗或符合受体条件的核素治疗。
- 两类均需同步处理胆道梗阻、疼痛和营养问题。
text.en:
- Resectable ductal adenocarcinoma: surgery and perioperative systemic treatment; locally advanced or metastatic disease mainly uses systemic treatment and symptom control.
- Neuroendocrine tumors: selected small, slow-growing nonfunctioning lesions may be monitored; other options include surgery, somatostatin analogues, targeted therapy, chemotherapy or receptor-eligible radionuclide therapy.
- Address biliary obstruction, pain and nutrition alongside either pathway.

text.zh-CN: 复评病灶与体能；胰腺功能受损或手术后评估消化、体重与血糖，功能性神经内分泌肿瘤还要追踪激素相关症状。
text.en: Review disease and fitness; assess digestion, weight and glucose after pancreatic dysfunction or surgery, and hormone-related symptoms in functioning neuroendocrine tumors.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 531,318 例，死亡 490,786 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 531,318 new cases and 490,786 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 白血病来自造血细胞；急慢性及髓系/淋巴系决定不同的诊断和治疗时序。
summary.en: Leukemias arise in blood-forming cells; acute versus chronic and myeloid versus lymphoid disease determine different treatment sequences.

text.zh-CN: 核心分支包括急性髓系白血病（AML）、急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）、慢性髓系白血病（CML）和慢性淋巴细胞白血病（CLL）。染色体、基因、免疫表型和治疗反应用于风险分层，不用统一的实体瘤 TNM。
text.en: Core branches are acute myeloid leukemia (AML), acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) and chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). Chromosomes, genes, immunophenotype and response guide risk; a universal solid-tumor TNM system does not apply.

text.zh-CN:
- AML：按分子风险和身体条件选择诱导/较低强度治疗与巩固，部分需异基因移植；急性早幼粒细胞白血病有独立的分化治疗路径。
- ALL：多阶段治疗并处理中枢神经系统风险；部分基因阳性使用匹配靶向药，复发时可评估抗体或 CAR-T（改造 T 细胞，使其识别并攻击癌细胞的治疗）。
- CML：以 针对 BCR::ABL1 融合基因所产生异常蛋白的靶向治疗及反应监测为核心，进展期另评估强化和移植。
- CLL：部分无症状者观察；有治疗指征后按病理风险、既往治疗和身体条件选系统治疗。
text.en:
- AML: molecular risk and fitness guide induction or lower-intensity treatment and consolidation, with allogeneic transplantation for selected patients; acute promyelocytic leukemia has a distinct differentiation-treatment pathway.
- ALL: multiphase treatment with CNS-directed care; eligible genetic subtypes receive matched agents, and relapse may allow antibody or CAR-T (chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy, which engineers T cells to recognize and attack cancer cells) options.
- CML: treatment directed at the abnormal protein produced by the BCR::ABL1 fusion gene and response monitoring; advanced disease may require intensification or transplantation.
- CLL: observation for selected asymptomatic disease; treatment indications trigger a risk-, fitness- and prior-treatment-based systemic plan.

text.zh-CN: 按类型追踪血常规、骨髓或分子/微小残留病变化；同时处理感染、出血和治疗相关器官毒性。
text.en: Track blood counts, marrow or molecular/minimal-residual-disease findings as appropriate, alongside infection, bleeding and organ toxicity.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 495,113 例，死亡 292,234 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 495,113 new cases and 292,234 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 食管癌影响把食物送入胃的通道，治疗兼顾肿瘤控制与吞咽。
summary.en: Esophageal cancer affects the passage carrying food to the stomach; treatment addresses cancer control and swallowing.

text.zh-CN: 主要分鳞状细胞癌与腺癌；病理、位置、分期和身体条件共同决定局部与系统治疗。
text.en: The main types are squamous carcinoma and adenocarcinoma. Pathology, location, stage and fitness guide local and systemic treatment.

text.zh-CN:
- 部分浅表病变：评估内镜切除。
- 可切除局部进展：常用术前治疗与手术组合；部分患者采用根治性放化疗。
- 不可切除/转移：化疗与适用免疫等系统方案；支架、放疗或其他支持措施可缓解吞咽梗阻。
text.en:
- Selected superficial lesions: assess endoscopic resection.
- Resectable locally advanced disease: commonly preoperative treatment and surgery; definitive chemoradiation is an option for some patients.
- Unresectable or metastatic disease: chemotherapy and eligible immune/systemic treatments; stents, radiation or supportive measures can relieve obstruction.

text.zh-CN: 跟踪吞咽、体重及影像反应；治疗后新发或加重的吞咽困难需要复评原因。
text.en: Track swallowing, weight and imaging response; new or worsening swallowing difficulty after treatment needs reassessment.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 494,320 例，死亡 441,994 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 494,320 new cases and 441,994 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 本组包括唇和口腔的原发癌，舌前部与口咽的舌根在目录中分开。
summary.en: This group covers lip and oral-cavity primaries; the front of the tongue is separated from the oropharyngeal tongue base.

text.zh-CN: 常见路径为鳞状细胞癌。具体部位、浸润范围、颈淋巴结与切缘影响方案。
text.en: The common pathway is squamous carcinoma. Exact site, invasion, neck nodes and surgical margins influence treatment.

text.zh-CN:
- 早期局限：手术或放疗，依部位与功能选择。
- 局部进展：手术与颈部淋巴结处理，结合术后放疗或放化疗等风险适配方案。
- 转移/复发：复评局部挽救机会与系统治疗，包含适用免疫方案。
text.en:
- Early localized disease: surgery or radiation according to site and function.
- Locally advanced disease: surgery and neck-node management with risk-adapted postoperative radiation or chemoradiation.
- Metastatic or recurrent disease: reassess local salvage and systemic options, including eligible immunotherapy.

text.zh-CN: 头颈检查与口腔、牙齿、吞咽和语言功能随访一起安排。
text.en: Combine head-and-neck assessment with oral, dental, swallowing and speech follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 452,205 例，死亡 194,108 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 452,205 new cases and 194,108 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 肾实质癌与肾盂尿路上皮癌共享统计组，但手术与系统治疗路径不同。
summary.en: Renal parenchymal and renal-pelvis urothelial cancers share a statistical group but follow different surgical and systemic pathways.

text.zh-CN: 先区分肾细胞癌与肾盂尿路上皮癌。肾细胞癌的病理类型、分期和复发风险影响治疗；不能把肾盂病变自动按肾细胞癌处理。
text.en: First distinguish renal cell carcinoma from renal-pelvis urothelial carcinoma. Renal-cell histology, stage and recurrence risk affect treatment; renal-pelvis disease should not automatically receive a renal-cell regimen.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限肾细胞癌：部分或全肾切除；不适合手术者可评估消融或其他局部方案。
- 高风险术后或转移性肾细胞癌：按适应证评估辅助免疫或免疫/靶向系统治疗。
- 局限肾盂尿路上皮癌：评估肾输尿管切除或选择性保留手术；进展后按尿路上皮病理路径处理。
text.en:
- Localized renal-cell cancer: partial or total nephrectomy; assess ablation or other local options when surgery is unsuitable.
- High-risk postoperative or metastatic renal-cell disease: assess eligible adjuvant immunotherapy or immune/targeted systemic treatment.
- Localized renal-pelvis urothelial cancer: assess nephroureterectomy or selected organ-preserving surgery; advanced disease follows its urothelial pathway.

text.zh-CN: 复查肿瘤影像与剩余肾功能，肾盂尿路上皮癌另按尿路路径安排随访。
text.en: Review tumor imaging and remaining kidney function; renal-pelvis urothelial disease also requires urinary-tract follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 442,570 例，死亡 144,871 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 442,570 new cases and 144,871 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 子宫体原发癌与宫颈癌分组不同；子宫内膜癌和子宫肉瘤也需要分别规划。
summary.en: Uterine-body cancers are separate from cervical cancer; endometrial carcinoma and uterine sarcoma require distinct plans.

text.zh-CN: 病理先区分内膜上皮来源与子宫肌肉/间质来源，并记录分级及会改变治疗的受体或分子结果。
text.en: Distinguish endometrial epithelial disease from muscle or stromal sarcoma, recording grade and treatment-relevant receptor or molecular findings.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限子宫内膜癌：手术与适当淋巴结评估；术后放疗或系统治疗按风险选择。
- 局部进展/转移或复发：系统治疗、放疗及选择性手术组合，部分激素敏感病变可用激素治疗。
- 子宫肉瘤：采用本身的病理与手术/系统治疗路径，不直接照搬内膜癌方案。
text.en:
- Localized endometrial cancer: surgery and appropriate nodal assessment; postoperative radiation or systemic treatment is risk-selected.
- Locally advanced, metastatic or recurrent disease: systemic treatment, radiation and selected surgery; hormone-sensitive disease may have endocrine options.
- Uterine sarcoma: use its own pathology-specific surgical and systemic pathway rather than applying an endometrial regimen.

text.zh-CN: 随访阴道出血、盆腔或其他新症状及治疗反应，处理手术、放疗或激素治疗后的功能影响。
text.en: Follow vaginal bleeding, pelvic or other new symptoms and response, while addressing functional effects of surgery, radiation or hormone treatment.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 434,620 例，死亡 100,680 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 434,620 new cases and 100,680 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 本组负担指皮肤原发黑色素瘤；眼或其他非皮肤原发病变按相应原发部位导航。
summary.en: This burden group concerns skin-primary melanoma; ocular and other non-skin primaries follow their primary-site navigation.

text.zh-CN: 肿瘤厚度、溃疡、淋巴结和远处转移影响分期。进展性疾病的可用分子靶点会改变系统治疗。
text.en: Thickness, ulceration, nodes and distant spread affect stage. Actionable molecular findings can change systemic treatment for advanced disease.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限病变：切除，按风险考虑前哨淋巴结评估。
- 较高风险或区域病变：局部治疗与适用的围手术期/辅助免疫或靶向治疗。
- 不可切除/转移：免疫或符合分子条件的靶向治疗，并评估选择性局部处理。
text.en:
- Localized disease: excision with risk-selected sentinel-node assessment.
- Higher-risk or regional disease: local treatment and eligible perioperative/adjuvant immune or targeted therapy.
- Unresectable or metastatic disease: immunotherapy or molecularly eligible targeted therapy, with selected local treatments.

text.zh-CN: 复查皮肤、淋巴结与所需影像；治疗中的新器官症状可能需要毒性评估。
text.en: Review skin, nodes and indicated imaging; new organ symptoms during treatment may require toxicity assessment.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 337,969 例，死亡 58,398 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 337,969 new cases and 58,398 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 卵巢癌包含多种病理；上皮性癌是此处的主要治疗路径。
summary.en: Ovarian cancer includes several pathologies; epithelial cancer is the main treatment pathway presented here.

text.zh-CN: 上皮性卵巢癌与部分输卵管/原发腹膜癌临床管理相近，但统计归属按原发部位保留。生殖细胞或性索间质肿瘤另走专病路径；BRCA 等结果可影响上皮性癌治疗。
text.en: Epithelial ovarian cancer is often managed with related fallopian-tube and primary-peritoneal cancers, while statistical assignment retains the primary site. Germ-cell and sex-cord stromal tumors have separate pathways; BRCA findings can influence epithelial treatment.

text.zh-CN:
- 早期上皮性：分期手术，按风险决定术后化疗；生育保留仅用于适合的选择性患者。
- 进展性：减瘤手术与化疗，顺序按可切除性和身体条件确定；维持治疗按病理、标志物与前线反应选择。
- 复发：依据既往治疗、反应持续时间及耐受性重订方案。
text.en:
- Early epithelial disease: staging surgery and risk-selected chemotherapy; fertility preservation is limited to suitable selected patients.
- Advanced disease: cytoreductive surgery and chemotherapy, sequenced by resectability and fitness; maintenance depends on pathology, markers and prior response.
- Recurrence: revise treatment by previous therapy, duration of response and tolerance.

text.zh-CN: 结合症状、影像与适用肿瘤标志物复评；CA-125 升高也可见于非癌症情况，需放在整体证据中解释。
text.en: Use symptoms, imaging and applicable markers together; CA-125 can rise in non-cancer conditions and needs contextual interpretation.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 330,731 例，死亡 203,850 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 330,731 new cases and 203,850 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 脑与脊髓原发恶性肿瘤以病理和分子特征分层，不能直接套用其他实体瘤的分期。
summary.en: Primary malignant brain and spinal tumors are stratified by pathology and molecular features rather than a universal solid-tumor stage.

text.zh-CN: 胶质瘤等类型的分级、位置和 IDH 基因、1p/19q 染色体变化、MGMT 基因调控状态等分子检测帮助分类、判断预后或治疗反应。脑转移沿用原发癌归组；中枢神经系统淋巴瘤归淋巴瘤。
text.en: Grade, location and applicable molecular tests—IDH gene changes, 1p/19q chromosome changes and MGMT gene regulation—inform glioma classification, prognosis or treatment response. Brain metastases retain the original cancer group; CNS lymphoma belongs to lymphoma.

text.zh-CN:
- 能安全切除：在保护神经功能的前提下手术并获得病理。
- 术后或不能切除：按类型、分级、分子特征和体能选择放疗、化疗或其他适用治疗；部分较慢病变可监测。
- 复发：重新评估病灶、既往照射和功能，选择再手术、放疗、药物或试验。
text.en:
- Safely resectable disease: surgery and tissue diagnosis while preserving neurological function.
- After surgery or if unresectable: type-, grade-, marker- and fitness-based radiation, chemotherapy or other eligible treatment; selected slower lesions may be monitored.
- Recurrence: reconsider disease, prior radiation and function for surgery, radiation, drugs or a trial.

text.zh-CN: 随访影像、神经功能和癫痫等症状；治疗后影像变化需区分肿瘤活动与治疗效应。
text.en: Follow imaging, neurological function and symptoms such as seizures; post-treatment imaging changes require distinction between tumor activity and treatment effects.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 324,095 例，死亡 248,964 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 324,095 new cases and 248,964 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 骨髓瘤是浆细胞恶性疾病，可影响骨、肾和造血；不是由骨转移定义的骨癌。
summary.en: Myeloma is a plasma-cell malignancy affecting bone, kidneys and blood formation; it is not a bone cancer defined by metastasis.

text.zh-CN: 区分 意义未明的单克隆免疫球蛋白血症（MGUS）、冒烟型状态与达到治疗标准的活动性骨髓瘤。是否有症状不是唯一门槛：特定骨髓、轻链或影像指标也可界定需要治疗的疾病。
text.en: Distinguish monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (MGUS), smoldering disease and active myeloma requiring treatment. Symptoms are not the only threshold: specified marrow, light-chain or imaging findings can also define treatment-requiring disease.

text.zh-CN:
- MGUS 与部分冒烟型：按进展风险监测；高风险冒烟型需专门评估干预证据。
- 活动性骨髓瘤：多药诱导，按身体条件评估自体移植，随后巩固/维持。
- 复发/难治：按既往药物耐受与抗性选择新组合，部分患者可用细胞治疗或双特异性抗体。
text.en:
- MGUS and selected smoldering disease: risk-based monitoring; high-risk smoldering disease requires specific assessment of intervention evidence.
- Active myeloma: combination induction, fitness-based assessment for autologous transplantation, then consolidation/maintenance.
- Relapsed or refractory disease: choose new combinations by prior resistance and tolerance; cellular or bispecific-antibody treatments are options for selected patients.

text.zh-CN: 追踪单克隆蛋白/轻链及适用骨髓指标，同时评估贫血、肾功能、钙、骨病和感染。
text.en: Track monoclonal protein/light chains and applicable marrow findings, plus anemia, kidney function, calcium, bone disease and infections.

summary.zh-CN: 喉癌影响发声和呼吸，局部控制与保留功能需要同时规划。
summary.en: Laryngeal cancer affects voice and breathing; local control and function are planned together.

text.zh-CN: 多数临床路径针对鳞癌；声门、声门上或声门下位置及淋巴结扩散影响方案。
text.en: The main clinical pathway concerns squamous carcinoma; glottic, supraglottic or subglottic location and nodal spread influence treatment.

text.zh-CN:
- 早期：放疗或合适范围手术，可保留部分喉功能。
- 局部进展：选择手术及术后治疗，或保喉放化疗路径；残留或复发需复评挽救手术。
- 转移/复发：局部或系统治疗按范围和既往治疗选择，包含适用免疫。
text.en:
- Early disease: radiation or appropriately limited surgery may preserve laryngeal function.
- Locally advanced: surgery with postoperative treatment or a larynx-preserving chemoradiation pathway; residual or recurrent disease needs salvage reassessment.
- Metastatic or recurrent: local or systemic treatment according to extent and prior therapy, including eligible immunotherapy.

text.zh-CN: 随访肿瘤、气道、吞咽与发声；喉切除后需要语言和呼吸通路康复。
text.en: Follow tumor status, airway, swallowing and voice; laryngectomy requires speech and airway rehabilitation.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 193,937 例，死亡 96,619 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 193,937 new cases and 96,619 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 胆囊原发癌与胆管癌分组不同；有时在胆囊切除标本中意外发现。
summary.en: Gallbladder primaries are separate from bile-duct cancer and may be discovered unexpectedly after cholecystectomy.

text.zh-CN: 病理、肝脏邻近侵犯与淋巴结情况决定能否完整切除；不要把所有胆道癌当作同一手术范围。
text.en: Pathology, adjacent liver invasion and nodes determine complete resectability; biliary cancers do not all require the same operation.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限/部分局部进展：评估胆囊及周围组织切除范围，可能涉及部分肝与淋巴结，并评估术后治疗。
- 不可切除/转移或复发：系统治疗与症状处理；胆道梗阻可评估引流或支架。
text.en:
- Localized or selected locally advanced disease: assess resection of the gallbladder and surrounding tissue, potentially including liver and nodes, and postoperative treatment.
- Unresectable, metastatic or recurrent disease: systemic and symptom-directed treatment; assess drainage or stenting for obstruction.

text.zh-CN: 跟踪影像、肝胆功能和黄疸；引流后也需评估通畅与感染相关症状。
text.en: Track imaging, hepatobiliary function and jaundice; after drainage, assess patency and infection-related symptoms.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 126,384 例，死亡 92,029 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 126,384 new cases and 92,029 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 鼻咽位于鼻腔后方，与口咽、下咽是不同原发部位。
summary.en: The nasopharynx lies behind the nose and is distinct from the oropharynx and hypopharynx.

text.zh-CN: 病理及鼻咽、颅底和颈淋巴结的范围共同分期；部分鼻咽癌与 Epstein–Barr 病毒相关。
text.en: Pathology and extent in the nasopharynx, skull base and neck nodes guide staging; some nasopharyngeal cancers are associated with Epstein–Barr virus.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限早期：常以放疗为主。
- 局部进展：放疗与化疗组合，顺序随风险调整。
- 转移/复发：评估化疗、适用免疫及选择性局部挽救；治疗后的残余淋巴结可有手术评估。
text.en:
- Early localized disease: commonly radiation-based treatment.
- Locally advanced: combinations of radiation and chemotherapy, sequenced by risk.
- Metastatic or recurrent: assess chemotherapy, eligible immunotherapy and selected local salvage; residual nodes may warrant surgical assessment.

text.zh-CN: 头颈随访同时关注吞咽、听力、口腔与营养，复评新发局部或神经症状。
text.en: Head-and-neck follow-up also addresses swallowing, hearing, oral health and nutrition, with reassessment of new local or neurological symptoms.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 119,750 例，死亡 62,060 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 119,750 new cases and 62,060 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 口咽包括扁桃体和舌根等部位；与舌前部口腔癌分开。
summary.en: The oropharynx includes the tonsils and tongue base, separate from anterior-tongue oral cancer.

text.zh-CN: 鳞癌是主要路径；HPV 相关与非相关疾病采用不同分期分组，不能只看同一个期数比较预后。
text.en: Squamous carcinoma is the main pathway. HPV-associated and HPV-negative disease use different stage groupings, so an identical stage number does not ensure comparable prognosis.

text.zh-CN:
- 早期：手术或放疗。
- 局部进展：以放化疗等综合治疗为主，结合适当手术策略。
- 转移/复发：按既往手术、放疗和药物重新评估局部挽救或系统治疗，部分可用免疫。
text.en:
- Early disease: surgery or radiation.
- Locally advanced: multimodality treatment, commonly chemoradiation, with appropriate surgical strategies.
- Metastatic or recurrent: reassess local salvage or systemic treatment based on prior surgery, radiation and drugs; immunotherapy is an option for eligible patients.

text.zh-CN: 头颈检查与吞咽、语言、口腔及牙齿功能随访相结合。
text.en: Combine head-and-neck examination with swallowing, speech, oral and dental follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 107,887 例，死亡 51,823 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 107,887 new cases and 51,823 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 下咽是咽部下端，与吞咽和喉部保护紧密相关。
summary.en: The hypopharynx is the lower throat, closely involved in swallowing and protection of the larynx.

text.zh-CN: 主要路径为鳞癌；位置、邻近喉/食管侵犯与淋巴结扩散决定治疗范围。
text.en: The main pathway is squamous carcinoma; site, adjacent laryngeal or esophageal invasion and nodes determine treatment extent.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限病变：评估适当手术与放疗组合。
- 局部进展：手术加放疗/放化疗，或适用的非手术放化疗；是否保留喉功能需结合切除与功能结果。
- 复发/转移：评估挽救局部治疗、化疗及适用免疫。
text.en:
- Localized disease: assess appropriate surgery and radiation combinations.
- Locally advanced: surgery with radiation/chemoradiation or an eligible nonsurgical chemoradiation pathway; laryngeal preservation depends on oncologic and functional feasibility.
- Recurrent or metastatic: assess local salvage, chemotherapy and eligible immunotherapy.

text.zh-CN: 随访局部复发、气道、吞咽和体重；涉及喉咽切除时同步安排重建与语言康复。
text.en: Follow local recurrence, airway, swallowing and weight; laryngopharyngeal resection requires coordinated reconstruction and speech rehabilitation.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 91,464 例，死亡 49,748 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 91,464 new cases and 49,748 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 霍奇金淋巴瘤是独立的淋巴瘤组；治疗看病理、病变范围和早期反应。
summary.en: Hodgkin lymphoma is a distinct lymphoma group; pathology, extent and early response guide treatment.

text.zh-CN: 经典型与结节性淋巴细胞为主型需要区分。早期还分有利/不利风险，进展期不等于只能做症状治疗。
text.en: Distinguish classical disease from nodular lymphocyte-predominant disease. Early disease has favorable and unfavorable risk categories; advanced stage does not mean symptom-only treatment.

text.zh-CN:
- 早期经典型：化疗并按风险和反应选择放疗。
- 进展经典型：组合系统治疗，可包含适用的免疫或抗体药物。
- 复发/难治：挽救系统治疗，部分患者随后移植；结节性淋巴细胞为主型另按其路径评估观察、局部或系统治疗。
text.en:
- Early classical disease: chemotherapy with risk- and response-selected radiation.
- Advanced classical disease: combination systemic treatment, which may include eligible immune or antibody-based agents.
- Relapsed or refractory: salvage systemic treatment and transplantation for selected patients; nodular lymphocyte-predominant disease has its own observation, local and systemic options.

text.zh-CN: 疗效评价之外，长期随访关注治疗相关心肺、内分泌、生育和第二肿瘤风险。
text.en: Beyond response assessment, long-term follow-up addresses treatment-related cardiac, pulmonary, endocrine, fertility and second-cancer risks.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 84,555 例，死亡 19,515 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 84,555 new cases and 19,515 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 睾丸癌常按生殖细胞类型规划；即使扩散，治疗仍需认真评估根治机会。
summary.en: Testicular cancer is often planned by germ-cell type; potentially curative treatment remains relevant even after spread.

text.zh-CN: 区分精原细胞瘤与非精原细胞瘤；AFP、β-hCG 和 LDH 与影像、病理一起用于分期和风险判断。
text.en: Distinguish seminoma from nonseminoma; AFP, beta-hCG and LDH contribute to staging and risk alongside imaging and pathology.

text.zh-CN:
- 睾丸原发：通常先经腹股沟路径切除明确病理。
- 局限病变术后：按类型与风险选择监测、辅助治疗或淋巴结手术。
- 区域/远处病变：按类型和风险使用系统化疗等方案，部分残余病灶需进一步手术；精原细胞瘤的部分区域病变可考虑放疗。
text.en:
- Testicular primary: commonly inguinal orchiectomy to establish pathology.
- After surgery for localized disease: surveillance, adjuvant treatment or nodal surgery according to type and risk.
- Regional or distant disease: risk- and type-directed systemic chemotherapy and other treatment; some residual masses need surgery, while selected regional seminoma may have radiation options.

text.zh-CN: 随访标志物与影像，治疗前讨论精子保存，长期评估生育与治疗后功能。
text.en: Follow markers and imaging, discuss sperm preservation before treatment, and review fertility and longer-term function.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 70,863 例，死亡 9,240 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 70,863 new cases and 9,240 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 唾液腺癌包括多种少见病理，不能只凭腮腺或口腔肿块位置确定方案。
summary.en: Salivary-gland cancers include several uncommon pathologies; a parotid or oral mass location alone does not determine treatment.

text.zh-CN: 黏液表皮样癌、腺样囊性癌等行为不同；病理分级、神经侵犯、切缘与淋巴结影响治疗。
text.en: Mucoepidermoid, adenoid cystic and other carcinomas behave differently; grade, nerve invasion, margins and nodes influence treatment.

text.zh-CN:
- 可切除局限病变：以手术为主，按风险加入放疗。
- 局部进展或不可切除：由病理与位置决定放疗及系统治疗的适用性。
- 复发/转移：复核病理并评估局部治疗、病理/分子匹配治疗或试验；不同类型的药物证据不能直接互换。
text.en:
- Resectable localized disease: surgery with risk-selected radiation.
- Locally advanced or unresectable: pathology and location determine radiation and systemic options.
- Recurrent or metastatic: review pathology for local treatment, histology/molecular-matched treatment or trials; drug evidence is not interchangeable across types.

text.zh-CN: 随访局部和远处病灶，并评估面神经、吞咽、口干和口腔功能。
text.en: Review local and distant disease alongside facial-nerve, swallowing, dry-mouth and oral-function effects.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 55,229 例，死亡 20,707 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 55,229 new cases and 20,707 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 外阴癌位于外生殖器，病变范围和腹股沟淋巴结影响局部治疗。
summary.en: Vulvar cancer affects the external genitalia; local extent and groin nodes guide treatment.

text.zh-CN: 鳞癌是主要路径；皮肤/黏膜其他病理需单独确认。外阴上皮内病变与浸润癌的治疗范围不同。
text.en: Squamous carcinoma is the main pathway; other skin or mucosal pathologies require separate confirmation. Intraepithelial lesions and invasive cancer require different treatment extents.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限浸润癌：局部切除并按条件评估前哨或其他腹股沟淋巴结处理。
- 局部进展：手术、放疗和化疗按可切除性组合。
- 转移/复发：评估局部挽救和可耐受系统治疗；晚期证据较少，适用试验可纳入讨论。
text.en:
- Localized invasive disease: local excision with eligible sentinel or other groin-node assessment.
- Locally advanced: surgery, radiation and chemotherapy combined according to resectability.
- Metastatic or recurrent: assess local salvage and tolerable systemic treatment; evidence is more limited in advanced disease, and eligible trials can be discussed.

text.zh-CN: 随访局部皮肤、伤口、淋巴水肿和性功能，及时复评新病灶。
text.en: Follow local skin, wounds, lymphedema and sexual function, with reassessment of new lesions.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 48,894 例，死亡 18,868 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 48,894 new cases and 18,868 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 阴茎癌的局部控制需与排尿、性功能及腹股沟淋巴结管理一起考虑。
summary.en: Penile cancer treatment considers local control, urinary and sexual function, and groin-node management together.

text.zh-CN: 主要路径为鳞癌；浅表病变、浸润深度与淋巴结状态影响保留器官的可行性。
text.en: The main pathway is squamous carcinoma; superficial versus invasive disease and nodal status determine organ-preservation options.

text.zh-CN:
- 原位/部分浅表病变：选择局部手术或适用表面治疗。
- 浸润性病变：按范围选择保留性手术或部分/全切除，并评估淋巴结。
- 较大、淋巴结阳性或远处病变：可需系统化疗与其他局部治疗组合。
text.en:
- In-situ or selected superficial disease: local surgery or eligible surface treatment.
- Invasive disease: organ-preserving surgery or partial/total removal by extent, with nodal assessment.
- Bulky, node-positive or distant disease: systemic chemotherapy may be combined with local treatment.

text.zh-CN: 随访原发部位和腹股沟淋巴结，并处理排尿、伤口与性功能影响。
text.en: Follow the primary site and groin nodes, addressing urinary, wound and sexual-function effects.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 34,765 例，死亡 12,346 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 34,765 new cases and 12,346 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: Kaposi 肉瘤可累及皮肤、淋巴结或内脏，统一归本组。
summary.en: Kaposi sarcoma can involve skin, nodes or internal organs and stays in this group regardless of site.

text.zh-CN: 其临床背景包括经典型、HIV 相关和免疫抑制相关等；免疫状态与内脏受累影响治疗强度。
text.en: Clinical settings include classic, HIV-associated and immunosuppression-associated disease; immune status and internal-organ involvement influence intensity.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限皮肤病灶：可采用局部手术或放疗等。
- 广泛或内脏受累：评估系统治疗。
- HIV 相关：抗病毒治疗与肿瘤处理共同规划；免疫抑制相关需由原治疗团队评估免疫用药调整。
text.en:
- Limited skin lesions: local surgery, radiation or other local treatment.
- Extensive or internal-organ disease: assess systemic treatment.
- HIV-associated disease: coordinate antiretroviral and cancer treatment; immunosuppression-related disease requires review of immune-suppressing medicines by the original team.

text.zh-CN: 观察皮肤和内脏症状、免疫相关指标及治疗反应，不能只用皮肤病灶多少代表全部病情。
text.en: Follow skin and internal-organ symptoms, immune-related measures and response; skin-lesion counts alone do not describe the whole disease.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 34,230 例，死亡 10,727 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 34,230 new cases and 10,727 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 间皮瘤来自胸膜或腹膜等覆盖组织，不按肺癌或腹腔器官癌重复收录。
summary.en: Mesothelioma arises from linings such as pleura or peritoneum and is not counted again as lung or abdominal-organ cancer.

text.zh-CN: 明确原发覆盖面、病理和扩散范围；胸膜与腹膜病变的局部治疗路径不同。
text.en: Establish the lining of origin, pathology and extent; pleural and peritoneal disease have different local-treatment pathways.

text.zh-CN:
- 局限、可考虑手术：专科团队评估手术的适用性与多学科组合。
- 进展胸膜病变：评估化疗或免疫等系统治疗；胸水引流及胸膜固定可缓解症状。
- 部分腹膜病变：可评估减瘤手术与腹腔热灌注化疗，适用性取决于范围和身体条件。
text.en:
- Selected localized disease: a specialist team assesses surgery and multimodality options.
- Advanced pleural disease: assess systemic chemotherapy or immunotherapy; fluid drainage and pleurodesis can relieve symptoms.
- Selected peritoneal disease: cytoreduction with heated intraperitoneal chemotherapy may be assessed according to extent and fitness.

text.zh-CN: 跟踪呼吸或腹部症状、影像、体能与积液变化，并评估治疗毒性。
text.en: Track respiratory or abdominal symptoms, imaging, fitness and fluid accumulation, plus treatment toxicity.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 27,350 例，死亡 22,715 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 27,350 new cases and 22,715 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 阴道原发癌与宫颈癌或其他肿瘤延伸到阴道需要分清。
summary.en: Primary vaginal cancer must be distinguished from cervical or other cancers extending into the vagina.

text.zh-CN: 主要有鳞癌与腺癌；原位病变、局部浸润和远处病变的路径不同。
text.en: Principal types include squamous carcinoma and adenocarcinoma; in-situ, locally invasive and distant disease require different pathways.

text.zh-CN:
- 原位或选择性早期：局部手术或放疗。
- 局部进展：外照射与近距离治疗等放疗组合，部分联合化疗或手术。
- 转移/复发：症状控制与选择性局部/系统治疗；药物证据较有限，不能把宫颈癌结果直接当作阴道癌已证实获益。
text.en:
- In-situ or selected early disease: local surgery or radiation.
- Locally advanced: radiation combinations including external-beam treatment and brachytherapy, sometimes with chemotherapy or surgery.
- Metastatic or recurrent: symptom control and selected local/systemic treatment; drug evidence is limited, and cervical-cancer results are not direct proof of vaginal-cancer benefit.

text.zh-CN: 随访盆腔症状、局部复发以及膀胱、肠道和性功能影响。
text.en: Follow pelvic symptoms, local recurrence and bladder, bowel and sexual-function effects.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 18,143 例，死亡 7,484 人。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 18,143 new cases and 7,484 deaths.

summary.zh-CN: 临床入口主要介绍基底细胞癌与皮肤鳞癌；全球表格的统计范围较窄。
summary.en: The clinical entry mainly covers basal-cell and cutaneous squamous-cell carcinoma; the global table has a narrower scope.

text.zh-CN: 两类皮肤癌的侵袭性和晚期用药不同。日光性角化属于癌前病变；皮肤黑色素瘤、Kaposi 肉瘤和淋巴瘤各归专组。
text.en: Basal-cell and cutaneous squamous-cell cancers differ in behavior and advanced treatment. Actinic keratosis is precancerous; cutaneous melanoma, Kaposi sarcoma and lymphoma have separate groups.

text.zh-CN:
- 多数局限病变：切除、Mohs 手术或按部位/风险选择其他局部治疗。
- 不能用局部治疗或转移的基底细胞癌：评估适用靶向等系统方案。
- 同类进展皮肤鳞癌：可评估适用免疫治疗，不能沿用基底细胞癌药物路径。
text.en:
- Most localized lesions: excision, Mohs surgery or other site- and risk-selected local treatment.
- Basal-cell cancer unsuitable for local treatment or metastatic: assess eligible targeted and other systemic options.
- Correspondingly advanced cutaneous squamous disease: eligible immunotherapy may be considered rather than applying a basal-cell regimen.

text.zh-CN: 随访原部位与其他皮肤新病灶，高风险鳞癌还需相应区域评估。
text.en: Follow the treated site and new skin lesions, with regional assessment for high-risk squamous disease.

text.zh-CN: 原论文表 1：估计新发 1,138,314 例，死亡 58,721 人。此表口径排除基底细胞癌。
text.en: Original paper, Table 1: an estimated 1,138,314 new cases and 58,721 deaths. This table excludes basal cell carcinoma.

summary.zh-CN: 原发部位已知、但未在上面 34 个统计组中单列的癌症在这里导航。
summary.en: This group navigates known primaries not separately listed among the 34 statistical groups above.

text.zh-CN: 包括其他骨/软组织原发癌、肛管癌、肝外胆管癌和男性乳腺癌等。已归血液、Kaposi、间皮瘤或明确列出的器官组的肿瘤不重复放入这里。男性乳腺基础正文沿用既有乳腺癌文章；本组不是一种统一病理。
text.en: Examples include other bone/soft-tissue primaries, anal cancer, extrahepatic bile-duct cancer and male breast cancer. Tumors already assigned to hematologic, Kaposi, mesothelioma or explicitly listed organ groups are not duplicated here. Male breast fundamentals use the existing breast-cancer article; this group is not one pathological entity.

text.zh-CN:
- 软组织肉瘤：局限病变常以手术为中心，按类型、分级和部位组合放疗或系统治疗。
- 骨肉瘤：常用化疗与手术组合；其他骨肿瘤需先明确病理，不能共用骨肉瘤方案。
- 肛管癌：多数局部浸润病变以放化疗为主，残留/复发再评估手术；不能照搬直肠癌路径。
- 肝外胆管癌：可切除者评估手术；不可切除者评估引流、系统治疗及可用标志物。
- 其他少见原发癌：从病理和原发部位进入对应专病路径。
text.en:
- Soft-tissue sarcoma: localized treatment often centers on surgery, with radiation or systemic therapy according to type, grade and site.
- Osteosarcoma: commonly chemotherapy plus surgery; other bone tumors require their own pathology-specific plan.
- Anal cancer: most locally invasive disease uses chemoradiation, with surgery reassessed for persistence/recurrence rather than applying a rectal-cancer pathway.
- Extrahepatic bile-duct cancer: assess surgery when resectable; otherwise assess drainage, systemic treatment and actionable markers.
- Other rare primaries: follow a disease-specific route based on pathology and origin.

text.zh-CN: 随访计划随具体病理、分期和治疗变化；不同原发癌的疗效与费用应分别比较。
text.en: Follow-up depends on the specific pathology, stage and treatment; compare outcomes and costs separately for each primary cancer.

summary.zh-CN: 原发灶不明癌是在确认恶性肿瘤并完成相应检查后，仍未找到起源部位的诊断。
summary.en: Cancer of unknown primary is diagnosed when malignancy is confirmed but appropriate investigation has not identified its origin.

text.zh-CN: 先以病理、免疫表型和影像排除已能明确归类的疾病。病灶分布、细胞类型与可用分子结果帮助识别可按特定癌种治疗的亚群。
text.en: Pathology, immunophenotype and imaging first distinguish diseases that can be specifically classified. Distribution, cell type and actionable molecular findings can identify subgroups suitable for a site-specific approach.

text.zh-CN:
- 有指向性的选择性亚群：按相应临床/病理路径治疗，例如特定淋巴结或腹膜分布。
- 广泛且缺乏特定线索：评估可耐受的系统治疗、可用靶点与支持照护。
- 追加检查以能否改变方案为目标；如后续确定原发，更新其归属。
text.en:
- Selected suggestive subgroups: use the corresponding clinical/pathological pathway, such as particular nodal or peritoneal presentations.
- Widespread disease without a specific pattern: assess tolerable systemic treatment, actionable targets and supportive care.
- Further testing should address decisions that can change management; update assignment if an origin is subsequently established.

text.zh-CN: 用症状、功能和可测量病灶复评获益；同时记录治疗负担和患者目标。
text.en: Reassess benefit using symptoms, function and measurable disease, while recording treatment burden and personal goals.
